description_en: Modifies the name and description of an IPv6 Translation Service instance
description_zh: 修改IPv6转换服务实例的名称和描述信息
kebab_example: aliyun vpc modify-ipv6-translator-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --ipv6-translator-id ipv6trans-bp1858ys0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyIPv6TranslatorAttribute

parameters.help_en: The region of the IPv6 Translation Service instance. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh: IPv6转换服务实例的地域。 您可以通过调用DescribeRegions接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a unique value from your client to ensure that different requests have unique ClientToken values. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the IPv6 Translation Service instance
parameters.name: ipv6_translator_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the IPv6 Translation Service instance. The default value is the instance ID. The name must be 2 to 100 characters in length and must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-), but cannot start with http:// or https://
parameters.help_zh: IPv6转换服务实例的名称，默认为实例ID。长度为 2~100个字符，必须以字母或中文开头，可包含数字，英文句点（.），下划线（_）和短划线（-）。但不能以http:// 或https://开头。
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The description of the IPv6 Translation Service instance. The default value is empty. The description must be 2 to 100 characters in length and must start with a letter or a Chinese character. It can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-), but cannot start with http:// or https://
parameters.help_zh: IPv6转换服务的描述信息。默认值为空。长度为2~100个字符，必须以字母或中文开头，可包含数字，英文句点（.），下划线（_）和短划线（-）。但不能以http:// 或https://开头。
parameters.name: description
